decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet is close to the core offer, was launched recently with its own web page, and represents invested development and approval effort, so after only one year management would attribute any weak results to market ramp-up and keep it.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core offer and therefore more vulnerable, but the regulatory investment and its visible presentation on its own page push management to persist through its first full year rather than admit a misstep.
The combination antihypertensive line has several models, is close to the established offer and is publicly presented, so heavy investment and commitment make dropping it within a year very unlikely.

The supplement involved little investment and is only mentioned on the website, which makes it easier to drop, but it fits the announced strategy of pharmacy-exclusive health products, so management likely keeps it for now.
